title: Empty promo code 500s checkout
author: meera
body:
POST /checkout dies with 500 if promo_code is "". We used to treat blank as no promo. Staging repro: add item, leave promo field empty (not omitted), pay.

Stack is in the thread. Happened twice for enterprise trial accounts this week.

title: Webhook retries stampede Stripe
author: arjun
body:
invoice.paid handler isn't idempotent. Stripe retry + our own 3x retry = 6 charges on a slow webhook. Need a processed_events table keyed on event id.

Saw this in the 7 Aug incident, ~40 duplicate invoices.

title: Export CSV silently drops refunds
author: meera
body: Finance noticed Q2 export didn't include refunds after 12 Jun. Fixed in #29. Left this open until they signed off — they did on 28 Jul.

title: Add refunds to the billing export
author: arjun
body: Shipped. Refunds show as negative rows with the original invoice id in column G.

title: Q3 goal: cut checkout p95 under 400ms
author: priya
body: We're at ~620ms p95 on checkout. Biggest chunk is the promo service (sync HTTP). Plan was to cache by code, but empty-string bug (#41) should land first or we cache the bad path.
